verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical: same left text stack, same CTA, and the same reworked circles. The yellow circle now sits behind the whole text block and the peach circle is fully contained behind the button, instead of bleeding off the edges as in the original, which makes both feel more cluttered and less intentional. Both also keep the tiny, barely legible chip labels ('BLOOD ORANGE', etc.), and B's slightly looser vertical spacing is not enough to separate them.
